## Assessment (2026-10-15)

**Verdict:** likely_vacant (0.74). The unit-specific active lease listing and its immediate-occupancy language indicate Suite 500 is probably being offered as vacant space. MLS marketing alone cannot prove physical vacancy.

**Start/duration:** Exact vacancy start is unknown. The earliest firm date in the reviewed evidence is the lease listing received Oct. 1, 2026; therefore the unit had been advertised as available for at least 14 days by Oct. 15, 2026. A separate sale listing has been on market since Feb. 21, 2026, but that does not establish vacancy over that period.

**Scope:** Suite 500 only. Other occupants at 900 Alice St in different suites do not establish Suite 500 occupancy. No utility, permit, code-enforcement, street-view, or vacancy-tax evidence was verified in this review.
